*Sound for parasites exploding into gore not playing
*[[Living Cleaver|Living cleaver]] V texture backwards
*[[Scent System|Scent]] entities being placed by parasites in [[Evolution Phases|phases]] < 0

====<u>Changes</u>==== 

*[[Crux]] throwing block ability is now affected by "Mobs with Griefing Task Blacklist" config option
*Crux will try to kill anything except water mobs and creepers (it is angry!)
*Crux now has AoE melee attacks
*[[Viral]] effect will always leave you with 1 heart instead of removing all of them
*"Mobs with new griefing task" changed "srparasites:crux;2;40;2" to "srparasites:crux;4;30;2"
*Removed old weapon component texture files from the mod
*zh_cn.lang file Updated by: 飘寂叶#2421
*ro_ro.lang file Updated by: Harbinger#5641
